scientific_limitations: Exactly two terminal-time martingale differences in real Hilbert spaces of dimension at least two.
Both deterministic increment caps must be strictly positive in the main three-phase expression.
Not an anytime or higher-horizon optimum; non-Hilbert Banach spaces excluded.
The comparison to literature is best-knowledge, not independent priority certification.
title: Sharp two-step Hilbert-martingale norm tails and their dimension gap
